provenance.title: Wheat phenomic prediction: grain and leaf NIRS and SNP markers (derived teaching subset)
provenance.source: Rincent et al. (2018), Phenomic selection, Recherche Data Gouv, doi:10.15454/MB4G3T
provenance.changes: 223 wheat varieties; target = grain yield in the irrigated (IRR) environment; grain and leaf NIRS of the irrigated trial as published (1st derivative of normalized spectra), every 4 nm (400-2496 nm, 525 points); 2000 SNPs drawn (seed 20261121) among markers with no imputed call and minor allele frequency >= 0.05, dosage = 2 x the published 0/0.5/1 coding; declared 20% test partition (seed 20261121).
provenance.limitation: Spectra are only published already pre-treated (normalized, 1st derivative): spectral preprocessing in the laboratory applies on top of that. One observation per variety; the yield of a single irrigated trial is the target.
